transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… my eating’s been kind of all over the place. Some weeks I barely want dinner, and then other nights I’m up late in the kitchen eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s gone to bed. It’s been bothering me enough that I thought I should come in.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?

I haven’t really weighed myself much, so I’m not sure about a number. It’s more that my appetite’s been strange… some weeks I barely eat dinner, and then other nights I’m in the kitchen late eating crackers or sweets.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, like within an hour?
Sometimes, yeah. Not always a huge amount, but there are nights I’m standing in the kitchen after everyone’s asleep, eating crackers or sweets kind of quickly. Then other weeks I barely touch dinner.
Do you usually eat those crackers or sweets when you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset?

I’m not really sure it’s always stress. It’s more just… my eating has been all over the place. Some weeks I barely touch dinner, and then some nights I’m in the kitchen after everyone’s gone to bed eating crackers or sweets.
Do you usually feel guilty after eating those crackers or sweets late at night?

Yeah… sometimes. Not so much just about the food, I guess. I can get stuck afterward, thinking I’ve messed things up over small stuff. Like buying some expensive paint pigment, or snapping at my spouse, and then it feels like I’ve ruined everything for the household.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control while eating those crackers or sweets late at night?

A little, yeah. I don’t know if I’d call it totally out of control, but some nights I’m just standing there eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s asleep, and it feels like my eating’s just… not normal lately. Some weeks I barely eat dinner at all.
Do you ever make yourself vomit or use laxatives after eating?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I don’t make myself throw up or take laxatives after.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most people would eat in a similar period of time?

I don’t know if it’s definitely larger than most people… It’s more that my eating is just all over the place. Some weeks I barely touch dinner, and then some nights I’m in the kitchen after everyone’s asleep eating crackers and sweets.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food and feel like you can't stop eating during that time?

I guess… kind of, but I don’t know if I’d call it a huge amount. It’s more like some weeks I barely eat dinner, and then other nights I’m just standing in the kitchen after everyone’s gone to bed eating crackers and sweets, and it feels hard to stop.
Do you have episodes where you feel like you're eating an unusually large amount of food in a short time?

Sometimes, yeah… not always. It’s more like my eating gets really uneven. Some weeks I barely eat dinner, and then other nights I’m in the kitchen late, eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s asleep. It feels like too much, I guess.
Do you feel like you can't stop eating or control what you're eating during those late-night episodes?

Yeah… sometimes it feels like I’m not really choosing it. I’ll just be standing there after everyone’s gone to bed, eating crackers or sweets, and it’s hard to make myself stop. Some weeks I barely eat dinner, so it’s just… all over the place.
Are you worried about gaining weight when you're eating those crackers or sweets late at night?

A little, I guess… but mostly I’m worried that my eating is just all over the place. Some weeks I barely eat dinner, and then other nights I’m up late eating crackers and sweets after everyone’s asleep.
Are you usually thinking about the calories or the potential weight gain when you're eating those crackers or sweets late at night?

Not really calories, no. I mean… maybe it crosses my mind, but mostly it’s just that my eating feels all over the place. Some weeks I barely eat dinner, and then other nights I’m just standing there eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s asleep.
Are you afraid of gaining weight when you eat normally during the day?
I don’t think so… not really. I don’t usually sit there worrying about weight if I’m eating normal meals.
Are you afraid of gaining weight in general, regardless of when or what you eat?
I don’t think so. I mean… I’m not thrilled about gaining weight, but I wouldn’t say I’m afraid of it all the time.
Are you afraid of gaining weight when you're eating those crackers or sweets late at night?
Not really afraid, no. It’s more… my eating just gets off. Some nights I barely eat, and other nights I’m in the kitchen eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s asleep.
Do you think your late-night eating of crackers or sweets is related to trying to avoid gaining weight?

No… I don’t think it’s about trying not to gain weight. It’s more that my eating’s just been all over the place. Some weeks I barely eat dinner, and then other nights I’m up eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s asleep.
Are you trying to control your weight when you eat very little during the day?

No… not really. It’s not like I’m trying to control my weight. I just… some weeks I barely touch dinner, and then other nights I’m eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s gone to bed. My eating’s just been all over the place.
Are you usually trying to avoid gaining weight when you have those episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time?

No… I don’t think I’m trying to avoid gaining weight. It’s just been kind of all over the place—sometimes I barely eat dinner, and other nights I’m standing there eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s asleep.
Do you often have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time, feeling like you can't stop?

Sometimes, yeah… not all the time. It’s more like some weeks I barely eat dinner, and then other nights I’m in the kitchen eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s gone to bed. It feels kind of… hard to settle down and stop once I start.
